article.story: EDMONTON, Alberta -- — Evan Bouchard scored on a power play at 3:32 of overtime to give the Edmonton Oilers a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Wild on Tuesday night. Connor McDavid set up Bouchard's goal for his third assist of the game, pushing his NHL-leading points total to 26 and extending his season-opening points streak to nine games. Leon Draisaitl scored twice, Mathieu Joseph also connected and Devon Levi made 27 saves. The Oilers (7-1-1) have won two in a row and seven of eight. Joel Eriksson Ek, Kirill Kaprizov and Ryan Hartman scored for Minnesota (6-2-2), and Jesper Wallstedt stopped 28 shots. Kaprizov leads the NHL with 11 goals. Kaprizov and Hartman scored in the third period as Minnesota overcame a 3-1 deficit to force overtime. Up next Wild: At Calgary on Thursday night. Oilers: Host Carolina on Thursday night. ------ See AP’s full NHL coverage here
